messages:
hana: Partner reported an unexplained +9k delta between their hourly export and our ledger for 2026-04-10T07:00Z. looks like duplicate aggregates arriving after intermittent gateway retries. anyone on call seen repeats?

omar: they confirmed their gateway will "retry hour" if upstream acks are missed. payloads are hourly aggregates with no idempotency key.

sue: painful. without an idempotency key we can't reliably dedupe. current ingestion upserts on (partner_id,hour,meter) but race conditions create duplicate rows then we SUM at reporting layer.

hana: suggested immediate mitigation: treat aggregate payloads as "replace" by default for that partner. that will collapse replays. longer term: require idempotency_key or sequence_number in webhook.

ben: technical approach: add optional fields to schema: idempotency_key (string), aggregate_mode ("replace"|"add"). ingestion rules: if aggregate_mode=="replace" then units = incoming. if add and idempotency_key present, dedupe by key; else reject with 422 and diagnostic.

omar: also add reconciliation alert: if partner_reported - our_ledger > 2% for an hour, auto-create PARTNER-RECON ticket and attach CSV. marketplace-bot can post.

marketplace-bot: scheduled job partner-hourly-check configured. will post discrepancy alerts to #partnerships-recon. next run in 10m.

sue: i'll draft schema + migration PR. hana, can you coordinate partner comms? we should give a 21-day migration window for additive partners.

hana: will do. action owners: @sue spec PR, @omar implement ingest change + test, @ben wire bot alerts, @hana partner notice. will update thread when PRs land. thanks :thumbsup:
